Hi Aisha —

Thanks — and congrats on getting the offer IDs ready. Quick answers and the intake checklist to move forward: 

1) AWS Marketplace billing: we prefer Marketplace-managed subscriptions when customers buy via the AWS channel (consolidated billing). For enterprise deals where customers request direct POs, we accept vendor invoices tied to our internal PO number. If you want Marketplace billing, we need your product code and a marketplace invoice flow set up.

2) Signed PO: For SSO/product listings we typically require a PO only for enterprise/contracted customers. For marketplace public listings, a signed Master SOW + standard marketplace listing terms are usually sufficient until a customer-specific PO is requested. However, Finance (cc: Vanessa) will require onboarding paperwork before we activate billing routing.

3) Tax forms: Please send a completed W-9 for the US entity and any VAT registration docs for EU sales. If Launchpad has multiple legal entities, clarify which entity will receive funds.

4) Evidence / security uploads: For Private deployments we need an evidence bundle (SOC2, pen-test summary, dataflow diagram) uploaded to our secure intake portal. Kimberly — can you confirm the upload link & retention requirements?

Action items:
- Aisha: share AWS product code screenshot + Azure offer export (you mentioned you have them).
- Launchpad accounting: confirm bill-to legal entity and remit address.
- Jordan/Kimberly/Vanessa: we will review SOW and send any standard contract addenda for marketplace terms.

I can do a 20-min sync today at 3pm PT or tomorrow morning; pick one and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Launchpad vendor onboarding — procurement / PO questions

Hi Aisha / Jordan —

Looping in the legal/ops checklist so Launchpad has a clear intake path. Our vendor intake typically needs the following to complete vendor activation and PO routing: 

- Completed vendor intake form (we'll provide a link).
- Legal: signed Master SOW + any marketplace addenda or consent to Redwood's standard platform terms. Redlines should be returned via DocuSign (we prefer tracked redlines in Word).
- Finance: W-9 (US) or VAT registration + certificate (EU).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), pen-test executive summary, and an inventory of hosting locations (region).
- Technical: product SKU/offer export (AWS product code, Azure offer ID, GCP listing ID) and a service descriptor (1-pager).
- Bank details for ACH if you expect direct payouts from enterprise customers (sensitive; we'll share secure intake link).

I've attached our vendor-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub) — it outlines the doc templates and expected retention periods. Typical onboarding SLA from complete paperwork to activation is ~7-10 business days; exceptions apply if legal redlines are extensive.

Vanessa, please confirm whether we need a pre-approved PO number before listing for marketplaces vs. direct enterprise invoicing.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
Vendor intake link (internal): https://redwood-inference.secure-intake.company/vendors/upload
Attachment: vendor-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub)
